integrity: Exact finite-support and residue identities are proved analytically; numerical checks supplement the proof. Relevant historical full texts that could not be accessed are explicitly identified as residual bibliography risk.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem applies to the quadratic uniform cardinal B-spline and a fixed evaluation point. Only remote right-hand unit-cell kernel suprema receive the exceptional faster rate. No general arbitrary-knot or global operator-norm improvement is claimed, and historical priority has not been independently established.
title: A unique one-sided superlocalization point for quadratic cardinal spline projection
